decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sharp multi-sample offset in N/E/U around indices 487–489 within the overlapping window [485,664], possibly indicating a transient platform or unresolved opposing motion; (2) an abrupt multi-axis jump near indices 607–609 in the [605,729] window, with sustained deviation and ambiguous recovery. Both involve overlapping windows and lack clean reversals, warranting closer inspection.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample drop in N and E (N from ~-0.2 to -2.1, E from ~-6.3 to -6.8) around index 487–489, followed by a sustained offset; U shows a concurrent rise then dip—suggests possible platform or opposing return not fully resolved.

Abrupt shift in all axes near index 607–609: N jumps from ~0.06 to ~0.74, E drops sharply (~-7.27 to -8.65), U rises (~-2.14 to -0.73); later samples show complex superposition of drift and possible partial return, with high variability through 625.
